judgement.reason: Label Studio supports PostgreSQL and S3-backed storage, so moving local data off disk is a contained change.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume ./mydata:/label-studio/data:rw (docker-compose.yml nginx), volume ./mydata:/label-studio/data:rw (docker-compose.yml app)
reviews.reason: The data directory holds uploaded files as well as the database, and no shown setting moves those uploads to S3, so the files would be lost on every restart.
